query: SELECT o.id AS "id!", (SELECT count(*) FROM org_memberships m WHERE m.org_id = o.id) AS "members!", (SELECT count(*) FROM projects p WHERE p.org_id = o.id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) AS "projects!", (SELECT count(*) FROM org_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.org_id = o.id AND m.preset = 'owner' AND u.state <> 'deleted') AS "owners!" FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS o(id)
